section: Rhode Island property tax: state rules
label: Municipal property tax levy cap

section: Rhode Island property tax: state rules
label: State tax on non-owner-occupied homes over $1 million
value: $2.50 per $500 of assessed value above $1,000,000, from the tax year beginning July 1, 2026
note: Statewide tax (R.I. Gen. Laws ch. 44-72) on residential property not occupied by the owner 183+ days a year; billed by the State. Threshold is indexed from 2027.
source_title: Rhode Island Code of Regulations: 280-RICR-20-75-1 Non-Owner Occupied Property Tax (active rule)

section: Rhode Island real estate transfer tax
label: Real estate conveyance tax
value: $3.75 per $500 of the sales price (raised from $2.30 on October 1, 2025)
note: Equivalent to 0.75%. Applies to the full price when consideration exceeds $100.
source_title: City of Cranston, RI: State Notice of Real Estate Conveyance Tax Rate Change

section: Rhode Island real estate transfer tax
label: Additional tier on residential sales over $800,000
value: Extra $3.75 per $500 on the portion of a residential sale price above $800,000
note: Tier 2 applies to residential property only, on the part of the price above $800,000, in addition to the Tier 1 tax on the whole price.
source_title: City of Cranston, RI: State Notice of Real Estate Conveyance Tax Rate Change

section: Rhode Island real estate transfer tax: figures under review
label: Who pays
value: Seller (grantor), unless the parties agree otherwise
note: From R.I. Gen. Laws 44-25-1; only seen in a search snippet.
source_title: Rhode Island General Laws 44-25-1, Real estate conveyance tax
